title: allium narcissiflorum var. minus
intro: Allium narcissiflorum var. minus, commonly known as Lesser Onion, is a plant species within the Amaryllidaceae family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, including its use in treating various health conditions. The Lesser Onion has been traditionally used to help reduce inflammation, alleviate colds, and relieve respiratory issues due to its therapeutic actions, which include expectorant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of Allium narcissiflorum var. minus include flavonoids, saponins, and other compounds that contribute to its health benefits, which may include antioxidant, anti-cancer, and immunomodulatory effects.
